title: Ren's Random Spawn
description:
I made a simple mod since I couldn't find one that did this without one issue or another or simply for other versions of Neoforge and other modloaders.

Gives everyone a random spawn point once. Can be reset using the command /rsreset playername
body:
Just a basic mod that gives everyone a random spawn point so everyone isn't all cluttered together. Checks to make sure you don't spawn in lava, water, or hundreds of feet in the air. 

You can reset individual players spawn point with /rsreset <playername>
